source_baseline.working_tree_at_artwork_start: README.md modified and Vision 1950 plan untracked from prior authorized documentation; parallel authorized gameplay/localisation implementation preserved.

scope: Two new Vision 1950 emergency special shipbuilding policy assets: dedicated decision row 32x32 and national spirit 60x68. No inherited artwork altered.
method: AI-generated raster originals using built-in image_gen.imagegen, one independent generation call per asset; original illustrated border/backing/motif retained. No external illustration or asset-pack component reused.

generation.model_note: Actual model identifier was not exposed in tool response; not inferred.
generation.attribution: AI-generated artwork; kpopmodder continuation work: policy-specific prompt specification, selection, native-size conversion, sprite integration and validation. Not attributed to original Hearts of Korea author or an external artist.

palette.application: Generation prompt requested navy/slate background with silver-gray metal subject and frame; this is a palette target with generated shading, not a fixed per-pixel fill. No whole-image hue filter or recoloring was applied.
palette.motif_relationship: Both depict naval ship construction; simplified ship and hammer for decision, shipyard crane and unfinished hull for spirit. No upgrade stages or ideology-dependent coloring.

operations: Preserve selected generated PNG unchanged in project docs/assets working directory.
Find source content bounding rectangle using alpha > 8 only for crop boundary; retain original per-pixel alpha.
Fit crop proportionally using System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic and SourceCopy; 1 pixel minimum decision margin, 2 pixels minimum spirit margin.
Export one mip level as uncompressed BGRA32 DDS (DDS_PIXELFORMAT RGB|ALPHAPIXELS, 32-bit masks 00FF0000/0000FF00/000000FF/FF000000).
Decode written DDS and compare every pixel to resized RGBA buffer; inspect decoded actual-size and 6x nearest-neighbor previews.
